lead_raw_text:
The structure of Ba2Mg12Si2 (reduced formula BaMg6Si) crystallizes in the tetragonal space group I-4m2 (No. 119), with 16 atoms per unit cell distributed over four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies close-packed-like local arrangements: Ba and Si centers each have 12 Mg neighbors, while Mg centers show 12 neighbors (8 Ba, 4 Mg, or 10 Mg plus 2 Si, depending on orbit), with neighbor distances ranging from about 3.25 to 3.63 Å. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 16 sites. Validated polyhedron contacts reveal Mg–Mg 12-vertex polyhedra sharing corner, edge, and face types, and Ba–Mg polyhedra sharing corners and faces.
